verdict.rationale: macOS's own docs cite Shortcuts for task automation. Safari Notify Me is a user-configured background monitor that watches pages for changes and alerts the user, which is a narrow form of autonomous background automation. The evidence never shows Shortcuts automations running unattended, on a schedule, or by trigger. missing for 10: documented background/scheduled or trigger-based execution of Shortcuts automations, breadth of autonomous automation beyond Safari page monitoring, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Safari Notify Me monitors pages for changes — for example, a price change or restock — and alerts you when it’s time to act.
